title: pilot_reset
description: Emitted by the plugin when a pilot resets their drone. With reason "respawn" it is sent the moment the game respawns the drone, and says how long the abandoned attempt had run. With "gms_series_mismatch" the reset was only noticed at the pilot's next lap, and nothing is known about the attempt.

reason.description: "respawn" (seen as it happened) or "gms_series_mismatch" (inferred at the next lap)

attempt_ms.description: respawn only: how long the abandoned attempt ran, from attempt_from to the reset

attempt_from.description: respawn only: "lap" when the pilot was flying on from a completed lap; "respawn" when measured from their previous respawn, so including the wait at the start and the run-up to the line

laps_in_run.description: respawn only: laps completed since the pilot's previous respawn

is_host.description: Since 1.4.0. Always true when sent: a copy of the plugin in a room its game doesn't host writes this to its own race log with false and doesn't send it
